import json, os, sys, time, tempfile, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime
t0 = time.monotonic(); ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1073741824, 1073741824))
def T(S): return S ^ ((S << 1) | (S << 2))
def f(a, b, c): return a ^ (b | c)
row = 1
for want in (1, 7, 25, 111, 401):
    assert row == want, (row, want)
    row = T(row)
TARGET = 0x642fdfb
assert TARGET.bit_length() == 27
OFF, SZ = 50, 110
def step(row):
    out = [0]*SZ
    for i in range(1, SZ-1): out[i] = f(row[i-1], row[i], row[i+1])
    return out
widths = {}; hits = []; checked = 0
for S in range(1, 8192, 2):
    s = S.bit_length(); n = 27 - s
    widths["%02d" % s] = widths.get("%02d" % s, 0) + 1
    r = [0]*SZ
    for k in range(20): r[OFF-k] = (S >> k) & 1
    Rt = S
    for t in range(n+1):
        Et = 0
        for k in range(2*t+14): Et |= (r[OFF+t-k] << k)
        assert Et == Rt, (S, t)
        if t == n:
            X = Rt >> n
            assert X.bit_length() == 27, (S, X)
            if X == TARGET: hits.append([S, n])
        r = step(r); Rt = T(Rt)
    checked += 1
assert checked == 4096, checked
exp_widths = {'01': 1, '02': 1}
exp_widths.update({'%02d' % s: 2**(s-2) for s in range(3, 14)})
assert widths == exp_widths, widths
R4_9 = T(T(T(T(9)))); X9 = R4_9 >> 4
assert X9 == 205
R6wit = {}
for S in (1, 3, 5, 7):
    s = S.bit_length(); n = 6 - s; Rn = S
    for _ in range(n): Rn = T(Rn)
    R6wit.setdefault(hex(Rn >> n), []).append([S, n])
print('checked=%d hits=%d widths_ok=True T4(9)=%d/%s X=%d' % (checked, len(hits), R4_9, hex(R4_9), X9))
print('R6 witnesses:', json.dumps(R6wit))
assert not hits
cpu = next((l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')), 'unknown')
src = open(__file__).read()
summary = {'target_hex': hex(TARGET), 'target_degree': 27, 'seeds': 4096, 'per_width_counts': widths,
 'expected_widths_match': True, 'hits': hits, 'nohits': True, 'all_degree_27': True,
 'T4_9_dec': R4_9, 'T4_9_hex': hex(R4_9), 'X_of_S9_dec': X9, 'R6_witnesses': R6wit}
rec = {'experiment_id': '20260905_physical_named_0x642fdfb', 'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
 'question': 'problem1', 'hypothesis': 'x=0x642fdfb has no late physical representation among all 4096 odd S with s<=13 at n=27-s.',
 'backend': 'python-cellarray-vs-packed-exhaustive', 'parameters': {'S_odd_range': [1, 8191], 'degree': 27, 't_max': 26, 'order': 'S-ascending-full-edge-compare', 'wall_limit_seconds': 120, 'address_space_bytes': 1073741824},
 'hardware': {'cpu_model': cpu, 'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count(), 'peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},
 'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()}, 'runtime_seconds': time.monotonic()-t0,
 'result_hashes': {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(), 'result_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()},
 'source_text': src, 'result_summary': summary,
 'interpretation': 'Zero hits: this generic pairing obstruction is absent from the late physical domain; sampled agreement was not relied upon.',
 'status': 'finite-exhaustive', 'proof_scope': 'All 4096 odd seeds, full packed-vs-cellarray edge agreement at every time step; no sampling.',
 'limitations': ['Late representations (n>=s) only.', 'Single named x; no all-depth claim.']}
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', prefix='rec_', suffix='.tmp')
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(rec, f, sort_keys=True, indent=2); f.write(chr(10)); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, '/tmp/physical_named_independent.json')
print('wrote /tmp/physical_named_independent.json')
